description: What happens to one LZ diagram when it is analysed, its graphics are edited, or its view or name change, as frontend/src/feature/lzWorkspace/useLzWorkspace.js's reducer does it (the reference), with `updatedAt` and `dirty` left out because the native apps stamp those when they save. `diagram` is what the case starts from, `expected` what the diagram is afterwards. A refused action leaves `expected` equal to `diagram`.

ops.name: analysis completes a targeted diagram
analysis completes an analyzed one again, replacing what it found
analysis keeps the fields it was not given
analysis of a draft with no target is refused
analysis with nothing in it still marks the diagram analyzed
a non-object analysis adds nothing but still completes
a draft of an analysis (a hand-drawn boundary) leaves the status alone
a draft on an analyzed diagram keeps it analyzed
a draft with no target is refused
resetting analysis returns to targeted, empties the analysis and keeps the graphics
resetting a draft with no target does nothing
resetting a targeted diagram changes nothing that matters
the terrain raster is set as runtime data
the same raster again changes nothing
a raster can be cleared
no raster is set on a diagram with no target
graphics cannot be set before analysis
graphics cannot be set on a draft
setting graphics replaces only the collections given
setting graphics can replace the export box
setting graphics can clear the export box
a legacy collection name in a patch is not applied
a patch with a collection that is not an array empties it
a collection is set whole
non-object items in a collection are kept
a collection can be emptied
a collection that does not exist is refused
a collection cannot be set before analysis
a new graphic is added at the end
a graphic with a known id is merged, keeping fields it did not mention
a graphic with no id is always added
an item that is not an object is refused
a graphic in a collection that does not exist is refused
a graphic cannot be added before analysis
a graphic is patched by id
patching an id that is not there changes nothing
a patch that is not an object changes nothing
patching with no id is refused
a graphic is removed by id
removing an id that is not there changes nothing
removing from a collection that does not exist is refused
a patch by number does not touch the text with the same digits
a patch by text does not touch the number with the same digits
an item with a null id is found by a null id
patching with no id is refused even when an item has a null id
removing by number leaves the text with the same digits
a graphic with no id is added, and does not merge into an item whose id is null
a graphic with a null id merges into the item with a null id
a null plural in a patch falls back to the legacy name
a view change keeps the fields it does not mention
an analysis that names a field as null clears it
flight data is merged
flight data on a draft is allowed
flight data that changes nothing changes nothing
the view is merged
a view change on a draft is allowed
the name is set
a null name is an empty name

defaultDoghouses.name: an object target with lat and lon
an object target with lat and lng
a namespace with odd characters is made safe
a namespace with a character outside the basic plane
no namespace falls back to the position to six places
an empty namespace falls back to the position
a tie in the sixth place rounds away from zero
a longitude near the date line
a target that is not a position gives none

afterAnalysis.name: a first analysis makes the SP and RP doghouses
a second analysis does not make them again
an analyzed diagram that already has doghouses keeps its own
a draft with no target is left alone
